description: Source code for handling Netscape SPKI structures in OpenSSL, including functions for encoding, decoding, and managing public keys within SPKI objects.

methods.name: NETSCAPE_SPKI_set_pubkey
methods.description: Sets the public key in a Netscape SPKI structure.

methods.name: NETSCAPE_SPKI_get_pubkey
methods.description: Retrieves the public key from a Netscape SPKI structure.

methods.name: NETSCAPE_SPKI_b64_decode
methods.description: Decodes a base64-encoded SPKI string into a Netscape_SPKI structure.

methods.name: NETSCAPE_SPKI_b64_encode
methods.description: Encodes a Netscape_SPKI structure into a base64 string.
